```java
/** 
 * Creates an account for the given user and password.
 * @param providerFactory the ProtocolProviderFactory which will createthe account
 * @param user the user identifier
 * @param passwd the password
 * @return the <tt>ProtocolProviderService</tt> for the new account.
 * @throws IllegalStateException if password is null when password remember is enabled
 */
public ProtocolProviderService installAccount(ProtocolProviderFactory providerFactory,String user,String passwd) throws IllegalStateException {
  Hashtable accountProperties=new Hashtable();
  if (registration.isRememberPassword()) {
    if (passwd == null) {
      throw new IllegalStateException("Password cannot be null when password remembering is enabled");
    }
    accountProperties.put(ProtocolProviderFactory.PASSWORD,passwd);
  }
  if (protocolProvider != null) {
    providerFactory.uninstallAccount(protocolProvider.getAccountID());
    this.protocolProvider=null;
  }
  AccountID accountID=providerFactory.installAccount(user,accountProperties);
  ServiceReference serRef=providerFactory.getProviderForAccount(accountID);
  ProtocolProviderService protocolProvider=(ProtocolProviderService)IcqAccRegWizzActivator.bundleContext.getService(serRef);
  return protocolProvider;
}
```
</最终结果>

</问题答案>
